traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Actinidiaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire or serrate; veins pinnate; stipules present; plants hermaphrodite, monoecious or dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers solitary or in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit usually capsule, sometimes berry; parts of each whorl (4-) 5 (-7); stamens (10-) 18 to 100; carpels 5 to 20. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
